newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn mixed, soy firms, wheat flat.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn mixed, soy firms, wheat flat.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf corn basis offers were mixed on Wednesday while soybeans firmed one cent a bushel amid subdued activity, export sources said.
Soft red winter and hard red winter wheat were steady.

India was reported to have bought one million bushels of Australian wheat, one dealer said. Several U.S. grain export sources said on Wednesday that India bought at least one million tonnes of Australian wheat in the past 24 hours.
The sale was divided into three shipments of 250,000 for August shipment, 250,000 tonnes for November and 500,000 tonnes for December, a trader said.
The deals were said to have been done at $154.25 to $155 per tonne, FOB.
European grain traders said the shipments were 250,000 tonnes each for August and October and 500,000 tonnes for December. There was was no official confirmation yet.
